title: Clean Discord cards, new Boosts hub, and faster forms
description: Removed the orange border from Discord bump alerts, combined shop and premium into one clean Boosts hub, and made workspace forms and uploads much smoother.
items: Discord bump cards now have clean neutral borders with zero orange stripe on the side
New Boosts tab in the server dashboard combining the server shop, active perks, and community ideas
Fixed form loading issues so your application builder and submissions inbox load instantly without errors
Automatic session security: CSRF tokens are handled in the background so claiming URLs and saving never fails
Fixed server manager permissions so real Discord server owners and managers can always claim custom URLs and perks
Added secure banner uploads supporting PNG, JPG, WebP, and animated GIFs for premium communities

title: Application builder, custom short links and live ER:LC stats
description: Create custom applications for your server, claim short links like connectingerlc.xyz/your-server, connect live in-game ER:LC stats, and boost your server with the new shop.
items: Custom application builder: make staff apps, partnership forms or ban appeals with 7 question types
Short application links that open at connectingerlc.xyz/your-server/form-name
Manager inbox to review applications, write notes, and accept or deny with instant Discord DMs
Automatic Discord roles given to applicants as soon as they are accepted
Claim your own short URL so your community page opens at connectingerlc.xyz/your-name
Old server links automatically redirect to your new short name
Redesigned public server pages with big banners, Discord member counts and verified badges
Live ER:LC in-game stats: connect your server key to display active players, staff on duty and queue size
Community reviews: rate and review servers with real Discord avatars (accounts must be at least 2 days old)
Server shop: buy 2x bump cooldowns, auto-bumping and monthly premium using your server balance
Apply for the official verified checkmark right from your dashboard
Clean Discord V2 notification cards with pure neutral borders and no side color stripe
Giveaway codes: redeem staff-created giveaway codes straight from your overview
Security warnings on all public forms and automatic 90-day pruning to protect applicant privacy

title: Christmas theme, bug reports and a faster bump engine
description: A seasonal Christmas look, a new way to report bugs and a big round of fixes for bumps, partnerships and live stats.
items: Christmas theme with red accents and light snowfall, with a snow on and off toggle
New /bugreport command. Accepted reports earn 50 credits for your server
Top banner for announcements, controlled from the admin portal
Join links now use a redirect page, so joins are tracked and credits are earned only after the member stays
Partnership requests now post your ad and DM the server owner with a V2 panel
Partnership requirements now say representatives, and the default is 1
Bump reminders now arrive exactly when the cooldown ends and only once
Bump reminders moved into Promote server and merged into one simple section
Bump, bug report and ad commands no longer show twice in Discord
Daily check-in reminders now use your real reset time
Home page stats now come straight from live data and update as servers join and bump
System status now shows live checks for the website, database, bot and ER:LC API
Earn credits and Partnership lists now have page controls
Fixed the Partnership established error
Fixed the unban command
Reviews now show your real Discord avatar and name
Danger zone merged into one clean card at the bottom of settings

title: V2 Bump Engine & Dynamic Telemetry Trajectory
description: Server bump counters and direct links, alongside dynamic Recharts member growth charts and directory pagination.
items: Bump counter and ConnectingERLC directory link on every server page
Dynamic verified member growth trajectory line chart powered by Recharts
Custom banner image upload in Promote Server Studio with real-time preview
Complete Anti-Raid & Churn Security suite with live defense shield rating and 72h retention enforcement
Paginated community directory discovery and joined communities management
Redesigned community growth tiers with transparent Vibra UI pricing cards and custom banners included on Free

title: ConnectingERLC Community Growth & Discord Directory
description: Major release introducing the real-time Discord directory and 72-hour credit retention guarantees.
items: 72-Hour retention guarantee enforcing automatic bounty clawback if an account departs early
Customizable community discovery cards with verified badges, real view tracking, and member counts
Interactive 5-star community rating system with instant feedback and ratings persistence
Bump button to elevate partner communities to the top of the directory with a 1-hour cooldown
Dedicated System Telemetry with live process memory (RSS & Heap), uptime duration, and API latency
Dynamic real-time notification engine linked to Discord user joins and daily rewards

title: Treasury Transfers & Multi-Server Discord Switcher
description: Added zero-fee credit transfers between Discord users and communities, alongside an instant multi-guild workspace switcher.
items: Zero-fee credit transfer hub with Discord Snowflake validation and instant balance deduction
Discord Workspace Switcher syncing user guild permissions and community avatars automatically
Multi-Category tagging (up to 3 categories) and Primary Community Language selector

title: 7-Day Daily Check-In Progression & Streak Rewards
description: Introduced an escalating 7-day reward calendar with automated streak resets and Day 7 grand milestone bounties.
items: 7-day escalating daily credit reward calendar (2 credits daily, 5 credits Day 7) with weekly auto-restart
Anti-abuse 24-hour countdown timer locked to UTC midnight resets
Real-time treasury balance synchronization across all open browser tabs

title: Design Architecture & Glassmorphic UI Overhaul
description: Upgraded the dashboard foundation with dark glassmorphic styling, collapsible sidebar navigation, and command palette.
items: Collapsible sidebar with icon-rail support and centered avatars
Enhanced user profile menu with direct Back to Home Page routing and Discord status
Single-avatar header layout eliminating duplicate profile icons

title: Initial ConnectingERLC Platform Launch
description: The core platform engine connecting Discord communities with community growth tools.
items: Discord OAuth2 authentication with automated guild discovery and permission validation
REST API backend on Express v4 with encrypted configuration storage
